Hangover patches are ` [Highlight start] adhesive stickers infused with vitamins, antioxidants, or herbal extracts marketed to replenish nutrients lost from drinking alcohol [Highlight end] ` . Clinical evidence does not prove they prevent or cure hangovers, treat dehydration, or lower blood alcohol levels.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESdgHEIkXXJ3p3wivO0wMzj9Oi9Hf6V3NSwyP_q6AhPOUBjeEINACn6C3xYZcGFId7FA7xBSEZadlVbTnJZfH5U9mtdK412Dor4v6lbY2xzHnRHC2uhUi5YiP58hH2ORGS_cKyyMW9EcEph9zQYu-Qi3gLOkRyh8Q)[[2]](https://www.google.com/search?q=product&prds=pvt:hg,pvo:29,productid:5285234713742061798,catalogid:3263631957190950757,gpcid:17538725623872363868,mid:576462563309869937&ibp=oshop)

### How They Work & Evidence

- **Intended mechanism:** Brands claim ingredients like B vitamins, DHM, green tea extract, or amino acids absorb through the skin over several hours.
- **Scientific reality:** As noted by the [Cleveland Clinic](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESdgHEIkXXJ3p3wivO0wMzj9Oi9Hf6V3NSwyP_q6AhPOUBjeEINACn6C3xYZcGFId7FA7xBSEZadlVbTnJZfH5U9mtdK412Dor4v6lbY2xzHnRHC2uhUi5YiP58hH2ORGS_cKyyMW9EcEph9zQYu-Qi3gLOkRyh8Q) , there is no strong scientific proof that transdermal vitamin patches prevent hangovers, and products are sold as supplements rather than regulated hangover treatments.
- **What actually helps:** Drinking water, pacing alcohol intake, eating food, and getting enough sleep remain the most reliable ways to reduce hangover effects.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESYwHEIkXXDmJNJ4JwCMT9qdhjZf09_8qLp7VfWNApudl3f8WaDjr2NP4GzC4bPyXrGnz8c8FGJxs58eOpcQvXU7cD1cuuN7QxT4Dgh9d63xqZSDH3J6YU4vMRJXBbOa4WgU7H6A)[[2]](https://www.google.com/search?q=product&prds=pvt:hg,pvo:29,productid:11449974898459138764,catalogid:14147967879156761060,gpcid:6830835904035473406,mid:576462810763756483&ibp=oshop)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESdgHEIkXXJ3p3wivO0wMzj9Oi9Hf6V3NSwyP_q6AhPOUBjeEINACn6C3xYZcGFId7FA7xBSEZadlVbTnJZfH5U9mtdK412Dor4v6lbY2xzHnRHC2uhUi5YiP58hH2ORGS_cKyyMW9EcEph9zQYu-Qi3gLOkRyh8Q)[[4]](https://www.google.com/search?q=product&prds=pvt:hg,pvo:29,productid:5285234713742061798,catalogid:3263631957190950757,gpcid:17538725623872363868,mid:576462563309869937&ibp=oshop)[[5]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESjwEBxCJF13x8ZDHOV_1mwidv6cPW-g6EkjczL5kEKkjv9Vu-s6ke_lONVMGLMd-TZq8YQApwY0p_LrEyk1-PJTHPLGBYv5xHT5nXQEjLRWxRrTOSeeQIRHM55TAp-UpHD_bYHYwopcYtz-jW8124PrpmXZpi8A5yoRwmvot1sXZ8DhFoTnkFT1dZgelPcYHtuw)

### How to Use Them

- **Timing:** Most brands suggest applying a patch 30 to 60 minutes before drinking, though some allow application later.
- **Placement:** Stick onto clean, dry, hairless skin without lotion—such as the inner wrist, upper arm, shoulder, or hip—and rotate spots if using repeatedly.
- **Wear time:** Typical wear ranges from 8 to 12 hours (some state up to 24 hours), depending on the brand.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESZgHEIkXXH8sAw4L3F6tcvcnJxgPRSdAXtKvbEuGdsxMo_izRsVJ3sxtg_sEEulK_usgY1wqqqhayMO9KlNUhXkyrBdvAGUxypYwxXlCcgMJGfGy5ksenPWOoF0PKM04yBLapTIm6jg)[[2]](https://www.google.com/search?q=product&prds=pvt:hg,pvo:29,productid:9724756456873971606,catalogid:10683920241045599875,gpcid:16674383456518183530,mid:576462782935532133&ibp=oshop)[[3]](https://www.google.com/search?q=product&prds=pvt:hg,pvo:29,productid:5285234713742061798,catalogid:3263631957190950757,gpcid:17538725623872363868,mid:576462563309869937&ibp=oshop)[[4]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESYwHEIkXXDmJNJ4JwCMT9qdhjZf09_8qLp7VfWNApudl3f8WaDjr2NP4GzC4bPyXrGnz8c8FGJxs58eOpcQvXU7cD1cuuN7QxT4Dgh9d63xqZSDH3J6YU4vMRJXBbOa4WgU7H6A)[[5]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESdgHEIkXXJ3p3wivO0wMzj9Oi9Hf6V3NSwyP_q6AhPOUBjeEINACn6C3xYZcGFId7FA7xBSEZadlVbTnJZfH5U9mtdK412Dor4v6lbY2xzHnRHC2uhUi5YiP58hH2ORGS_cKyyMW9EcEph9zQYu-Qi3gLOkRyh8Q)[[6]](https://www.google.com/search?q=product&prds=pvt:hg,pvo:29,productid:518372463965660963,catalogid:9168746993445470992,gpcid:12371204378779299573,mid:576462605986793139&ibp=oshop)[[7]](https://www.google.com/search?q=product&prds=pvt:hg,pvo:29,productid:15845366959172062527,catalogid:14967469652600413009,gpcid:3616548324260902867,mid:576462502802959029&ibp=oshop)

### Potential Side Effects & Risks

- **Skin irritation:** Redness, itching, or rashes from adhesives or active ingredients.
- **Medication interactions:** Ingredients could interact with prescription medications, so check with a doctor or pharmacist first—especially if pregnant or nursing.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESdgHEIkXXJ3p3wivO0wMzj9Oi9Hf6V3NSwyP_q6AhPOUBjeEINACn6C3xYZcGFId7FA7xBSEZadlVbTnJZfH5U9mtdK412Dor4v6lbY2xzHnRHC2uhUi5YiP58hH2ORGS_cKyyMW9EcEph9zQYu-Qi3gLOkRyh8Q)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESZgHEIkXXH8sAw4L3F6tcvcnJxgPRSdAXtKvbEuGdsxMo_izRsVJ3sxtg_sEEulK_usgY1wqqqhayMO9KlNUhXkyrBdvAGUxypYwxXlCcgMJGfGy5ksenPWOoF0PKM04yBLapTIm6jg)[[3]](https://www.google.com/search?q=product&prds=pvt:hg,pvo:29,productid:518372463965660963,catalogid:9168746993445470992,gpcid:12371204378779299573,mid:576462605986793139&ibp=oshop)[[4]](https://www.google.com/search?q=product&prds=pvt:hg,pvo:29,productid:14273948527323390018,catalogid:13441216665986687706,gpcid:2246020067392904528,mid:576462575319223804&ibp=oshop)
